ns2:section.sectionText: Placement in this course requires a recent U of I Math Placement Exam score of at least 40%, with 50%-64% strongly recommended. Failure to achieve the minimum score will result in removal from the course after the fifth business day of fall term. Students with lower scores are encouraged to work through the Learning Module during the summer until they have reached the level of mathematical knowledge expected for this course. For details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS ..... This class has combined evening exams on September 14, October 12, and November 16.
